meta.title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellation Policy
meta.description: How shipping, cancellations, returns and refunds work at MELOVME.

policy.title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellation
policy.intro: At MELOVME, we want every order to feel as good as the products inside it. Here is exactly how shipping, cancellations, returns and refunds work, so you always know what to expect.

shipping.title: Shipping
points: Every order is carefully packed and dispatched within 2–3 business days.
Delivery times depend on your location and our courier partners.
You can follow your order anytime in <orders>My Orders</orders>. Once it ships, your tracking number appears there too.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
points: You can cancel your order anytime before it is shipped: open it in <orders>My Orders</orders> and tap “Cancel order”.
Once an order has been shipped, it can no longer be cancelled.
Paid online? We refund the full amount to your original payment method. Cash on delivery? There's nothing to pay.

returns.title: Returns & Replacements
points: For hygiene and safety, body care products can't be returned once delivered, unless they arrive damaged, leaking or incorrect.
If something is wrong with your order, tell us within 48 hours of delivery, with your order number and photos.
An unboxing video, recorded from opening the sealed package, is required for any claim of missing, leaking, broken or incorrect items.
Once we verify your claim, we send you a replacement at no extra cost. Incorrect items must be unused, in their original packaging.

refunds.title: Refunds
points: Refunds apply to orders cancelled before shipping and are made to your original payment method only (UPI, card or bank account).
Once we start a refund, it usually reaches your account in 5–7 business days, depending on your bank.
Delivered orders are not refunded; damaged, leaking or incorrect items are replaced instead (see Returns & Replacements).
Cash on delivery orders cancelled before shipping are never charged, so there is nothing to refund.

contact.title: Need help?
contact.text: For cancellations, returns or refunds, reach out with your order number and a short description of the issue. We're happy to help.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: What personal information MELOVME collects, how it is used and protected, and your choices.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We only ask for what we need to get your order to you, and we treat it with care. This page explains what we collect, why, who helps us handle it, and the choices you have.

collect.title: What we collect
points: Your mobile number, to log you in with a one-time code (OTP) sent by SMS.
Your name and delivery addresses, to deliver your orders and contact you about them.
Your orders: what you bought, the amount, how you paid (for example UPI or card) and the delivery status.
Reviews you write, shown with the name you choose, and messages you send us through the contact form (name, email, phone and message).

use.title: How we use it
points: To process, pack, deliver and support your orders, including cancellations, replacements and refunds.
To send you updates about your orders by phone or WhatsApp, and to reply to your messages.
To keep your account secure and prevent fraud.
We never sell your personal information, and we don't use it for third-party advertising.

payments.title: Payments
points: Online payments are handled securely by Razorpay, our payment gateway.
We never see or store your card number, CVV, UPI PIN or bank login details.
We keep only the payment reference and method (for example “PhonePe · UPI”), to match payments to orders and to make refunds.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
points: Only the services we need to run the shop: our delivery partners (your name, address and phone, to deliver your order), Razorpay (payments), Firebase by Google (login codes), MongoDB Atlas (our secure database, hosted in India) and EmailJS (contact form messages).
If you choose to chat with us on WhatsApp, those messages are handled by WhatsApp under its own privacy policy.
We may share information if the law requires us to.

cookies.title: Cookies & your browser
points: We use one essential cookie to keep you logged in. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.
Your cart and wishlist are saved in your own browser, not on our servers, so they stay on your device.

rights.title: Your choices & rights
points: You can see and update your name in your profile, and your delivery addresses at checkout, at any time.
You can ask us for a copy of your information, to correct it, or to delete your account. We keep order records for as long as the law requires for tax and accounting.
We handle your information in line with applicable Indian law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
If we change this policy, we'll update it here and change the date at the top of this page.

contact.title: Questions about your data?
contact.text: Write to us about your information or privacy, and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
